title.en: The trillion-dollar climate promise faces a delivery test
title.zh: 万亿美元气候承诺，面临怎样的落地考验？

summary.en: Simon Stiell argues that affordable terms, easier access and country-led institutions matter alongside finance targets.
summary.zh: Simon Stiell提出：气候融资除了金额目标，还需要可负担的条件、便捷的获取途径和由受援国主导的制度。

title.en: Twelve coral species were hiding behind other names
title.zh: 十二种珊瑚，曾藏在别的名字后面

summary.en: Museum references and modern genomics refine coral identities, giving conservation a sharper starting point.
summary.zh: 博物馆标本与现代基因组证据厘清珊瑚身份，为保护工作提供更准确的起点。
